name: PWA RELEASE CANDIDATE
changes: Added a contextual VA HOME Journal proof bridge to all 18 product pages
Linked each product to one relevant editorial guide in static HTML
Removed the legacy discovery-18 to discovery-17 outbound conversion
Kept server-side discovery-17 compatibility for previously saved carts
Reserved the product rating line while asynchronous reviews load
Converted the orphaned Discovery Set guide card into a full-width CTA
Refined product Journal links into quiet inline editorial notes
Updated resource query versions to 13.7.0-rc13
Added one restrained About-to-Journal bridge inside Molecular Architecture
Reserved the catalog rating slot when a product has no approved reviews
Aligned price, compare control and product actions across reviewed and unreviewed cards
Restored the intended mobile inset for Molecular Architecture and the editorial design caption
Added a globally legible dark glass header over light imagery
Added an installable VA HOME PWA for iPhone and Android
Added branded 192, 512, maskable and Apple touch icons
Added a restrained offline page and versioned static asset cache
Kept account, cart, order, admin, Supabase and live commerce files network-only
Excluded refills and incomplete online payment integration from release scope
Prevented broken Google OAuth inside iPhone standalone PWA and added a clear email/Safari fallback
Hidden the sticky checkout action while the iOS keyboard is open
Kept focused checkout fields inside the reduced visual viewport
Removed the large empty black gap between the checkout form and the editorial footer scene
Hidden the mobile checkout CTA for the entire checkout-entry zone in both PWA and mobile browsers
Removed the iOS fixed/backdrop checkout layer after entering the form and repaired the visual viewport after keyboard dismissal
Physically detaches the mobile checkout CTA while the checkout form is active
Restores the CTA only after scrolling back above the checkout form
Disables the old iOS root compositor repaint transform that could leave a black lower strip
Clears all mobile bottom reserve while entering checkout data
